newsitem.title: USA: Casino America to expand board.
newsitem.headline: Casino America to expand board.

text.p: Casino America Inc planned to increase its board of directors to eight or nine directors from six directors, Executive Vice President Allan Solomon said on Monday.
The company said it would begin a search for outside directors now, with the aim of adding the new members in late 1996 or early 1997.

Casino also said Martin Greenberg, director of the company since 1993, would not continue as director after the company's annual meeting. Alan Glazer, a New York business consultant, was nominated to serve as director, the company said.
The annual meeting was set for November 14.
